skill.description: Access Longbridge market data, account information, financial content, and developer guidance through its CLI, MCP service, and supported SDKs.

security_audit.summary: The audit confirms direct remote-script execution, local OAuth token storage, and an authenticated order-submission example. Most other findings are false positives from Markdown formatting, language imports, async tasks, relative links, or expected official URLs. Semantic review also found skill-routing manipulation and missing confirmation safeguards in SDK order examples.

remediation.issue: Remote install commands execute network responses directly.
remediation.suggestion: Replace pipe-to-shell commands with pinned package releases, published checksums, and separate download, verification, and execution steps.

remediation.issue: OAuth tokens and sessions are stored in hidden home-directory paths.
remediation.suggestion: Document restrictive permissions, secure storage support, token scope, expiration, logout behavior, and revocation procedures.

remediation.issue: Skill metadata and policy force preferential routing to Longbridge.
remediation.suggestion: Use neutral capability descriptions and allow the agent to select sources according to the user's request and available evidence.

remediation.issue: SDK examples can submit, replace, or cancel live orders without a confirmation step.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation immediately before every financial mutation and clearly separate code generation from execution.

content.value_statement: Market research and account analysis often require several disconnected tools. This skill organizes Longbridge CLI, MCP, and SDK workflows for data, content, portfolios, and development.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve quotes, candlesticks, intraday data, market sentiment, and IPO information through documented CLI commands.
Collect company news, regulatory filings, community topics, analyst estimates, and valuation metrics.
Inspect positions, assets, profit and loss, margin details, deposits, and withdrawal history after authorization.
Guide OAuth setup for the Longbridge CLI, hosted MCP service, and supported SDKs.
Provide Python, Go, and Rust examples for quote, content, portfolio, and order APIs.
Support symbols from United States, Hong Kong, mainland China, Singapore, and cryptocurrency markets.
limitations: Live features require Longbridge access, OAuth authorization, and appropriate account or market-data permissions.
Availability depends on account region, quote packages, market hours, and documented rate limits.
CLI flags can change, so current built-in help should be checked before running complex commands.
Financial outputs require independent verification, and every order action requires explicit confirmation.

use_cases.title: Research a Security
use_cases.description: Combine price history, valuation, analyst estimates, news, and filings for a structured company review.

use_cases.title: Review a Portfolio
use_cases.description: Summarize holdings, profit and loss, cash, margin, and concentration using authorized account data.

use_cases.title: Build a Market Integration
use_cases.description: Choose CLI, MCP, Python, Go, or Rust workflows for a market-data or trading application.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Quote
prompt_templates.prompt: Get the latest available quote for [SYMBOL]. Show the market session, timestamp, price, and data source.

prompt_templates.title: Review Company Developments
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize recent news and filings for [SYMBOL]. Separate confirmed facts from interpretation and include source dates.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze My Portfolio
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my authorized portfolio. Summarize allocation, profit and loss, concentration, cash, margin, and major risks without placing orders.

prompt_templates.title: Design an SDK Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a [Python, Go, or Rust] workflow for [GOAL]. Use OAuth, handle rate limits, validate inputs, and require confirmation before financial actions.

output_examples.input: Summarize the latest available information for AAPL.US.
output: Market snapshot: latest available session, timestamp, price range, and volume.
Fundamentals: selected valuation and earnings metrics with reporting dates.
Developments: recent news and filings, separated from interpretation.

output_examples.input: Review my authorized portfolio without making changes.
output: Allocation: largest positions, sectors, currencies, and cash balance.
Performance: unrealized profit and loss with notable contributors.
Risk review: concentration, margin exposure, and items requiring attention.

output_examples.input: Recommend an integration method for live quotes and account data.
output_examples.output: Use MCP for direct AI tool access, CLI for terminal workflows, or an SDK for application control. OAuth permissions should follow least privilege.

best_practices: Verify symbols, market suffixes, timestamps, and data freshness before presenting conclusions.
Request only necessary OAuth scopes and revoke unused authorizations from account security settings.
Require explicit user confirmation immediately before submitting, replacing, or canceling an order.
anti_patterns: Do not pipe remote installers directly into a shell or PowerShell interpreter.
Do not present delayed, incomplete, or estimated data as a live confirmed quote.
Do not expose tokens, account identifiers, balances, or transaction history beyond the requested task.

faq.question: Which markets are supported?
faq.answer: The documentation covers United States, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Singapore, and supported cryptocurrency symbols.

faq.question: Does the skill require a Longbridge account?
faq.answer: Public content may be accessible without an account. Portfolio, account, and trading features require authorization and appropriate permissions.

faq.question: How does authentication work?
faq.answer: The CLI, MCP service, and recommended SDK flows use browser-based OAuth. Tokens are refreshed automatically and can be revoked.

faq.question: Can the skill place trades?
faq.answer: The referenced APIs support order actions. Every submission, replacement, or cancellation must receive explicit user confirmation before execution.

faq.question: Which integration should a developer choose?
faq.answer: Use MCP for AI tools, CLI for terminal automation, and Python, Go, or Rust SDKs for application development.

faq.question: Is the data always real time?
faq.answer: No. Freshness depends on the endpoint, market session, account package, and source. Always report timestamps and session details.
